title: Google says users in the US can now link to and interact with some apps in AI Mode, including Instacart, Canva, and YouTube Music (Aisha Malik/TechCrunch)
summary: Aisha Malik / TechCrunch: Google says users in the US can now link to and interact with some apps in AI Mode, including Instacart, Canva, and YouTube Music — Google announced on Thursday that it now allows users to link and interact with some of their go-to apps right in AI Mode, the tech giant's conversational search experience.
